change_summary: Stacked on PR 544. Add strict win/push/loss validation (engine/nfl_wpl.py), a temporary capture wrapper around frozen v5 outcome functions with order-independent numeric matching and hold-when-unavailable pricing (engine/nfl_wpl_capture.py), a research CLI (engine/run_nfl_wpl.py), regression and real-v5 CLI tests, and workflow wiring. Numeric matching is not selection-level provenance; rows without a unique, validated match are held. Frozen v5 and run_nfl.py are unchanged.
assumptions: Passing CI shows the regression suite executes; it does not validate predictive accuracy, calibration, odds, or profitability.
Binding of outcome mass to rows is by exact numeric reproduction, not by event/market/player/threshold identity; this PR is on HOLD for selection-level provenance.
The capture wrapper is intended for a dedicated process and restores every patched name on exit; it is not thread-safe outside run_nfl's lock.
engine/sportsedge_v5.py is frozen and unchanged; every row is PAPER/0u and NON_COUNTED.
